item.title: Kubernetes Networking: Pods, Services, Gateway API and Network Policy
item.description:
Simple definition#

Kubernetes networking answers four questions: how Pods talk to each other, how clients find a stable address for a changing set of Pods (Services), how external traffic gets in (Gateway API / Ingress), and how traffic is restricted (NetworkPolicy).

item.title: Service Mesh: Istio, Linkerd, Cilium and Ambient Mode
item.description:
Simple definition#

A service mesh is an infrastructure layer that handles service-to-service communication for you: encrypts it with mutual TLS, applies traffic rules (retries, timeouts, canary weights), enforces identity-based authorisation, and emits telemetry — without changing application code.
